import math

# Coarse weekly sim from d161 (end wk23). Cash 276,173. Book 110,928.
# Model: leads = paid + r0*book*(1-book/C); conv (S1) at eff $13 ~ 0.90 (scenario param)
# adds pay first-mo (13*0.957 + 60*0.043) ~ $15.0 avg
# renewals: explicit calendar wk24-28 listed, then ~book*22/4.286 listed thereafter approx
# r1 churn ~13% of cohort 4wks prior (eff13 cohorts), 19% for eff-4 cohorts (wk23 adds, hit wk27/28)
# mature churn 0.3%/wk of book. collection r1 0.82 baked into churn; mature collect 0.97
# costs: ops = arrivals/0.56 = (0.092*book)/0.56 per day; dev 39.2K/wk; cap 28K/wk; ads 75.3K/wk;
# compute = book*0.158*0.0062 per wk (K units); leads*0.5

def sim(conv=0.90, C=230_000, r0=0.247, paid_wk=15_600, weeks=26, verbose=True):
    cash = 276_173.0
    book = 110_928.0
    adds_hist = {23: 24_789}  # week -> adds
    # prior cohorts for r1 (approx from renewal calendar n)
    adds_hist.update({22: 12_986, 21: 10_500, 20: 11_500, 19: 11_000})
    cal_listed = {24: 316_942, 25: 435_112, 26: 459_887, 27: 699_543, 28: 441_805}
    out = {}
    for wk in range(24, 24 + weeks):
        avg_pre = book
        net_rate = r0 * max(0.0, 1 - book / C)
        leads = paid_wk + net_rate * book
        s1_leads = leads * 0.88
        adds = s1_leads * conv + 160  # S2
        adds_hist[wk] = adds
        # churn: r1 of cohort wk-4 (joined ~30d ago)
        coh = adds_hist.get(wk - 4, 11_000)
        r1_rate = 0.19 if (wk - 4) == 23 else 0.13
        cancels = coh * r1_rate + 0.003 * book
        new_book = book + adds - cancels
        avg_book = (book + new_book) / 2
        # revenue
        if wk in cal_listed:
            listed = cal_listed[wk]
            if wk == 27:
                listed += 0  # already includes wk23 partial; wk28 includes rest
        else:
            listed = avg_book * 22 * 7 / 30 * 0.97  # approx incl B mix bump
            # add first renewals of cohort wk-4 explicitly? roughly inside avg_book calc
        renew_collect = listed * (0.83 if wk in (27, 28) else 0.87)
        firstmo = adds * 15.0
        rev = renew_collect + firstmo
        # costs
        arrivals_d = 0.092 * avg_book
        ops = max(17_500, arrivals_d / 0.56) * 7
        compute = avg_book * 0.158 * 0.0062 * 1000 / 1000 * 7 / 7  # = avg_book*0.158*6.2/1000? keep explicit:
        compute = avg_book * 158 * 0.0062  # units/wk per sub=158 → $ per wk
        ads = 75_250.0
        dev = 39_200.0
        cap = 28_000.0
        if avg_book * 158 / 7 > 6_500_000:  # T5 trigger weekday approx
            cap = 70_000.0
        leadcost = leads * 0.5
        cost = ops + compute + ads + dev + cap + leadcost
        cash += rev - cost
        book = new_book
        out[wk] = (cash, book, rev, cost)
        if verbose and wk in (24, 27, 31, 35, 41, 49):
            print(f"wk{wk}: book {book:,.0f} rev {rev:,.0f} cost {cost:,.0f} net {rev-cost:+,.0f} cash {cash:,.0f}")
    return out
